section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Rear Axle Shaft
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Rear Axle Shaft

content.description: Illustration showing removal of axle flange nut using hammer and chisel to loosen staked part

items: (a) Using a hammer and chisel, loosen the staked part of the nut.

content.text: NOTE: Be sure to remove the washer from the axle shaft. If not, the axle flange cannot be removed with SST in the next step.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of axle flange using SST tool, with instruction to hold while disconnecting

content.text: Using SST, disconnect the axle flange and the washer.
NOTE: Be careful not to lose the plate washer on the tip of the flange bearing side.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of rear axle shaft and spacer using SST tool to pull out axle shaft with oil seal and outer bearing

content.text: 6. REMOVE REAR AXLE SHAFT AND SPACER
Using SST, pull out the rear axle shaft with the oil seal and outer bearing.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of inner oil seal and bearing from rear axle housing using SST tool

content.text: 7. REMOVE INNER OIL SEAL AND BEARING

items: (a) Using SST, pull out the inner oil seal from rear axle housing.

content.description: Cross-sectional diagram showing outer race and inside bearing components with directional arrows

items: (a) Using a brass bar, remove the bearing outer race from the rear axle housing.
(b) If necessary, replace the outer race.
